title: Crease reveal
description: An acid-yellow poster compresses into a faceted paper object and unfolds again.
useCase: Reveal the surface and volume of printed material through one reversible transformation.
interaction: Crumple the paper or adjust the crease.
reducedMotion: Deliberate controls update a still mesh without interpolation.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static poster appears if unavailable. A deterministic faceted deformation, not a physically accurate self-colliding sheet.
look: A faceted acid-yellow paper poster with heavy black sans type and a large arrow glyph, slightly crumpled, on a near-black olive background with yellow controls.
motion: Pressing the button crumples the flat poster mesh into a faceted ball, or flattens it, easing exponentially (about 95 ms time constant); the crease slider sets the deformation directly.
adapt: Deformation lives in `point`, blending the flat sheet and a noisy sphere by `amount` (`Math.pow(p, 0.78)`); `frame` eases `amount` toward `target` with a 95 ms constant. Redraw the 2D `paper` canvas with your artwork and keep `cr-fallback`.
